verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a public REST Marketing Emails API with concrete endpoints for creating, updating and retrieving emails, plus post-send statistics, and the docs are served in agent-friendly markdown. However, the evidence covers only the email surface, not the rest of Marketing Hub (social, landing pages, campaigns, attribution), and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage beyond marketing emails, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can use the Marketing Emails API to programmatically create, update, and get details about marketing emails.
To retrieve a list of all emails, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails`, and include any filters as query parameters in your request
To retrieve an individual email, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails/{emailId}`
You can also query details about the post-send statistics of a specific email or set of emails.
